independent_review.text:
# Independent review: form-field description source-role successor v3

Reviewed frozen stage SHA-256 `176cd97d24c1281ec4e3778bcdad366765a1a6caad88834440e62bd86f1d210c`, manifest SHA `f89675283f5f3d235a1d8a9147969ea65da9459c620ee0574754988dce210872`, and shared/current/frozen patches `7501d93fe5781bb015c387feffb100c0fce8088c7ade1d8891fadf781161afcd`, `7dc9e2d4f463cd4c8adf6841fd0d86b41f8ae31b99dc02d2b4058e34195f8ed8`, and `702f994dd8e78f7646a8d0e64d64314674b958aa4ba16174795756739c47c08e`, respectively, against base `8a0c4866dba602bd1f9c9916128f7537d986e0b9`. Strict isolated application yielded nine files matching the frozen stage. No canonical edits or installation.

No remaining blocking finding in this bounded source-role review. The earlier v2 stage was invalid: its 3+70 ledger rows referenced old review hashes despite updated review files; v3 corrects this. Independently checked each selected v3 row equals its frozen row-update candidate and each review reference equals the staged bytes. All 73 complete previous rows and previous reviews are retained; old evidence is retained, with the historical form-field image archived as Git-identical parent bytes where needed. The 42 autocomplete trigger roles retain their unchanged trigger source and historical runtime scope.

The actual 8a0 form-field Git diff removes a separate filtered described-by subscription and its cleanup and synchronizes IDs on each existing control state notification. Independently compared all 31 reviewed form-field identifier AST parent contexts before/after. Four historical peer roles are absent as current peer imports: BooleanInput is a local union and the three error helpers come from owned-errors; v3 explicitly preserves their prior owned-replacement decisions and does not misidentify them as live peer bindings. Source-role identity is not a claim that the changed lifecycle has no behavior impact. The committed repair record separately documents narrow packed and maintained-input-family observations, including prior limitations; the input-family execution predates the later input test relocation and is not represented as a rerun.

Independent real scanner observed 509 production files and 1,931 uses; the staged current population hash matches. Byte comparison outside 3 current and 70 frozen row nodes plus the declared current population/history values passed. Replayed the actual evidence evaluator on frozen v3 rows: current 328/3 to 331/0, frozen 1362/374 to 1432/304, exactly 3+70 resolved, no added insufficiencies, targeted source/context/root/archived-image/trigger mutations rejected; all 46 blocked removed-use rows remain unchanged and insufficient. The independent driver (`evidence-controls-v3.mjs` SHA `4caf2d80d8d30070131d6aa2ec9cc778703f1205bad43173c3bfb278b9b4d082`) explicitly loads v3 row files and its input hashes were identical before and after. Its `replay.log` SHA `72c0a7b6aae8af2199e6d5743c5178e452bee9b7836295b1c92299b4e772d149` records these results.

At review time HEAD advanced to `313984c7fe1a2d13bccd0afc33ac17d66cc1d8c5`; its only delta from base is the input test relocation/restoration and its review record, with no production-source change. No browser replay, full autocomplete or input family rerun, 21.x floor, production baseline, security, G11 or release qualification is claimed.

source_changes_after_review: Input test relocation/original aria-live assertion restoration and README guidance only; production form-field/trigger bytes, role-ledger preimages and repair-record bytes unchanged.
